GF-B11-03.description:
Weekly food cost control kit for independent restaurants: inventory sheets, recipe coster, variance dashboard, waste log, and par reorder discipline. A practical food cost control kit for independent restaurants: count sheets, a recipe coster, a variance dashboard, a two week waste log, and par reorder sheets, plus a weekly review routine that ties them together. You compute actual usage from opening inventory plus purchases minus closing inventory, compare it against theoretical cost from recipes, and investigate the gap each week. Illustrative examples show each formula step by step. WHAT IS INCLUDED:
['Operational guide (PDF)', '3 print-ready templates: Weekly Review Agenda, Recipe Cost Card, Waste Log Sheet'] WHO THIS IS FOR:
['Independent single-unit restaurant owners', 'Kitchen managers and head cooks who order product', 'Cafes and bistros with a fixed menu'] LIMITATIONS:
Designed for single-unit independent restaurants. Not built for multi-unit consolidation, commissary production, catering banquets, or bar and liquor inventory. Waste log relies on honest staff recording. Educational material only. Not accounting, tax, or legal advice. Illustrative numbers are fictional examples used to show the math. Actual results depend on suppliers, menu, labor, and local conditions. SUPPORT: Email support for file access and formula questions. Response within two business days. Custom menu costing and on-site training are not included.

GF-B10-05.description:
A focused 3-page scope-control micro-kit for solo freelancers: contracts basics, change-order handling, late-fee math, payment reminders, and demand-letter pointers for fixed-price and hourly work. Concise and practical - a starting framework, not a template library and not legal advice. No guaranteed outcomes, no reviews yet. Instant download (PDF).
